children: Quantum Cyber announced a sharpened strategic focus on quantum navigation, one-way attack/interceptor drones and U.S. manufacturing capacity.
Issued press release and furnished updated corporate investor presentation under Regulation FD on Sept 25, 2026.
Refocused platform on three pillars: quantum antenna, one-way attack/interceptor drones, and the MAHCA operating system.
Anchored manufacturing at owned ~50,000 sq ft Bridgeport, CT facility with an operational 80-unit 3D printing farm.
Management targets 100,000 drones/year as a forward-looking production capacity projection (not current capacity).
Commercial focus narrowed to Border Patrol, Warfare/Defense UAS, Law Enforcement, and GPS-Alternative/Quantum Navigation markets.
